Spring 2027 Full-Time Internship – Mountain View, CA

- Currently enrolled in a master’s degree program at an accredited college or university.

- Field of Study: Computer Science or other related fields.
- Business fluent English.
- Experience in coding in Phyton, coding in Android Automotive, integrating LLM results with existing/new APIs.
- Open and good communication skills, self-organized.
- Some technology know-how and interests: AI, LLM, Video and Audio processing.

- Medical insurance coverage.
- Paid time off in addition to company paid holidays where eligible.
- Hybrid work environment.
- Access to the Intern Vehicle Lease Program.

Control Systems & Site Reliability Engineering Co-op 
Boston, MA, USA (Spring 2027)

 About the Role 
QuEra is looking for a Control Systems & Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) Co-op to help keep the hardware and software behind our quantum computers running smoothly. You’ll join a team of software engineers, physicists, and hardware and test engineers, and you’ll get hands-on experience with the infrastructure that controls and tests real quantum machines. This co-op is a good fit for students who like to tinker, enjoy figuring out why something broke, and want to see how networking, Linux systems, and automation come together in a cutting-edge R&D lab.

 You’ll work under the guidance of experienced engineers on real projects that improve the reliability of our development and production environments.

 What You’ll Do 

• Help install, upgrade, test, and troubleshoot the hardware and software systems that control our quantum computers. 

• Write and improve documentation and step-by-step procedures for lab and system operations. 

• Support our lab and test infrastructure, including servers, network switches and routers, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test setups, and containerized services. 

• Write scripts (Python, Bash, or similar) to automate repetitive setup, configuration, and testing tasks. 

• Help build and maintain monitoring dashboards and alerts so the team can spot problems early. 

• Assist with keeping CI/CD pipelines, test result dashboards, and software repositories healthy and organized. 

• Join troubleshooting efforts when systems or builds fail, and help track down root causes. 

• Rack, cable, and set up servers and network equipment in the lab. 
 
 What We’re Looking For 

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 

• Comfort working in Linux from the command line (through coursework, personal projects, or prior jobs). 

• Some experience with a scripting or programming language such as Python, Bash, or Go. 

• Basic familiarity with Git and version control. 

• A working understanding of networking fundamentals such as IP addressing, DNS, and DHCP. 

• Curiosity, attention to detail, and a methodical approach to solving problems. 

• Clear communication and a willingness to ask questions and learn quickly. 
 
 Nice to Have 

• Experience with Docker or other containers; exposure to Kubernetes is a plus. 

• Exposure to CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) or configuration tools like Ansible. 

• Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Grafana or Prometheus. 

• Experience configuring network gear, building a home lab, or working with physical servers. 

• Experience with embedded systems, lab equipment, or hardware projects (robotics clubs, maker projects, research labs). 

• Interest in quantum computing, physics, or scientific computing. No prior quantum experience needed. 
 
 Why Join 
You’ll get real responsibility on systems that support some of the most advanced quantum hardware in the world, mentorship from engineers across software, hardware, and physics, and a front-row seat to how a fast-moving R&D company operates.

 The hourly rate for this co-op is $35-$45.

 QuEra is committed to cultivating a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We highly value diversity in our current and future employees and do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
